featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been Workout at Power Vibes Gym for the past three years, and suddenly I was told I’m no longer allowed to enter. When I asked for the reason, they said that CultFit Elite members are currently not allowed. This makes no sense because when I had asked Vikas during my renewal, he clearly told me there was no such issue, and that even if something changes in the future, my membership would continue normally.

I still have six months of membership left, yet no one is giving me a valid explanation. One person tells me to talk to the trainer, the trainer tells me to talk to Vikas, and both keep pushing the responsibility onto each other. It feels like they think the member has no rights and can be manipulated easily.

When the membership was being sold, everything was promised. But now, after taking the money, they are denying their own statements. They even suggested that I buy a new membership, instead of honoring the one I already have.

The gym equipment and environment are good — but the staff is extremely unprofessional.
They communicate with no clarity, no accountability, and no honesty.

Important Point
If the gym is not allowing CultFit Elite members, then kindly change the gym banner. Right now, CultFit has changed its Google profile name to “CultFit,” apparently for marketing, but members are still being denied entry. This is misleading, and it creates false expectations for anyone who checks the gym online.

Suggestion to the Owner
Please hire staff who are professional and transparent.
Anyone planning to buy a yearly membership, I strongly recommend getting all promises in writing via email, because the management keeps changing their statements and you could face the same problem.

After i mentioned the gym name, the receptionist tried to draw a boundary of what is expensive for me and what is not. Although she didn’t explicitly said that. But she twice mentioned to me that it will be very big change for you which was pointed in the direction of gym fees. I hope the management takes this into consideration.

featured_reviews.name: Krushabh Sanghavi
featured_reviews.review_text: Best gym in the area with excellent facilities and staff. Everyone is very helpful in the gym right from support staff to trainers, especially Adil Shaikh, who has the most knowledge and trains very well.

featured_reviews.name: Harman Chanana
featured_reviews.review_text: Fabulous gym and the best hygiene maintained here.Been a member since 2019 and will highly recommend the gym to people willing to transform.Highly profession trainers and well maintained equipments.

featured_reviews.name: Kavita Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text: Love the vibe and the crowd (super sincere and passionate which fab) - again the trainer is the really reason i am here (Karthik) and now this place is like second home - right from the trainer to housekeeping staff to Shabnam who handles the from desk - the people and machines - great combo to have

featured_reviews.name: Mona Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been working out at i5 fitness, Andheri since last year. I have found the place very comfortable for the workout. Never been so consistent this much before joining the gym. The staff is so supportive and trainers are very motivating. I have been training under Sachin Pradhan, he is also very knowledgeable.
